title: Repair OKX Hourly open-interest USD unit mapping without rewriting history
objective: Correct the verified positional four-field OKX open-interest-history parser defect: a current [ts, contracts, base currency quantity, USD notional] response stores base quantity in the supposed USD value field. Primary target ONLY actual USD value normalization and fail-closed parsing for malformed/ambiguous source shapes. Keep already-defined same-unit amount and price/OI state logic unchanged unless a separately reviewed source contract permits explicit unit conversion. Establish actual quantity unit lineage across shapes; no cross-unit return/delta and no combining pre-fix mislabeled notional and corrected notional as one continuous economic measure. Before code release enumerate existing consumers of *_open_interest_value and check their current source authority and compatibility; a change to a live signal, canonical source selection, output schema/authority, or historic data semantics requires separate source-owner review, not this task. Preserve original archived rows, prior forecasts and evidence. Use existing Hourly owner and tests, no new pipeline, scheduled task or additional model/API spend.

evidence.summary: Actual direct public OKX BTC and ETH per-instrument Nov19 four-field rows and current public archive matched 46/46: stored amount=contracts and stored USD value=base quantity; 0/46 stored values match actual USD. Public instrument specs validate contract-to-base identities. Entry dates, endpoints, matching tolerances and source limitations documented.

Exact current parser still reads numbers[0] as amount and numbers[1] as value, discards actual USD field. Dictionary branch and array branch also have different legacy quantity unit precedence. Re-read fresh main before repair.
Pinned original public source ref 2e13022bd4aa7dc9878d552b53f4b9126954ae5a; 24 hourly records each asset, 23 source-label matches each. Preserve original bytes; no backfill.
Existing fixture defines dict oiCcy and oiUsd, does not reproduce real four-element array. Extend existing producer-to-persistence test.
Public exchange endpoint used for reproduction; data retention may expire, so use synthetic exact-shape regression plus C08 receipt and immutable public archive evidence.
Vendor SDK confirms endpoint/argument contract; raw source and contract specifications establish current positional unit identity.

reproduction: Read current exact main build_hourly_sequence.py parse_okx_oi and build_rows. Synthetic four-slot response [1795129200000, '10000', '100', '6200000'] for BTC-USDT-SWAP (ctVal=.01) currently returns value=100 rather than 6200000; existing dict fixture {ts,oiCcy,oiUsd} does not catch this. Reproduce through parser and build_rows to *_open_interest_value, then through existing temp-root merge_rows persistence/reread. C08 independently reproduced 46 actual public archive rows. Different prior tasks #947/#694 and #1749 (funding clock) are not this failure. Do not claim source observation clocks or all historical extent; no live forecasts changed. Validate fresh source shapes before implementing. Root cause is positional decode, not data endpoint absence.

positive: Before implementation write failing synthetic 4-slot BTC and ETH arrays with distinct contract, base and USD numbers; after patch exact USD field is retained, no change to price or same-unit amount change semantics in existing supported shape; dictionary with explicit oiUsd retains correct USD.

Full existing Daily Capture Pipeline tests with native unittest collection count and new producer-to-persistence-to-reread fixture; observed USD value refers to true field, not base quantity. Existing equal-quality and degradation protections unchanged; no old archive file written by repair PR.

Verify independently against at least one natural new Hourly capture and public provider matching labels/units (source observation clock distinct from retrieval), compare actual source schema, instrument identity and correct USD; preserve receipts and history. Consumer census and immutable old/new unit boundary signed off before release.
negative: Reject or explicitly mark unavailable ambiguous/truncated or shifted arrays, booleans, nonfinite or invalid numeric fields, missing USD, unknown shape; never treat base quantity as USD or silently substitute quantity for missing USD. Include adversarial mutation restoring old index and prove new regression fails.

Reject duplicate/conflicting source timestamp identities and mixed ambiguous quantity units for derived return only under existing fail-closed source contract; if a schema or output semantic change is required, stop/escalate rather than invent policy. No silent multiplication or inference of historical USD, no false freshness or PIT.

Synthetic original archive rows retain original immutable values on regression replay; no comparison of pre-fix mislabeled versus corrected USD as same-unit series, no edit to existing archived/frozen outcomes. No new API spend or workflow, no signal gate or weight changes. If no consumer-safe unit boundary possible within scope, stop and request owner decision.

post_fix_gate: Current source owner and exact-head independent review; existing CI with nonzero test collection and adversarial old-index mutation proof; no existing archive data edits; original-unit provenance and affected consumer disposition; real next natural Hourly persisted row verified against exact public source, corrected USD field and same-unit quantity continuity. If unresolved previous rows or consumer semantics, retain quarantine/owner HOLD, not RESOLVED.
